zh.summary: 富达要求一位女性提供其前夫姐姐的死亡证明，突显了金融遗产处理过程中的官僚摩擦和成本。该文章探讨了对非直接受益人提出这些要求的荒谬性。

title: Soccer-FIFA scraps World Cup sell-off plan after resistance from members
summary: FIFA has abandoned its proposal to sell a stake in its business to outside investors after fierce resistance from member associations. The decision reflects concerns from member organizations about maintaining control over the organization.
content: FIFA said on Friday it will not proceed with its proposal to sell a piece of its business empire to outside investors after the project was met with fierce resistance from some of its member associations.

zh.title: 足球-国际足联在成员反对后放弃世界杯股权出售计划
zh.summary: 国际足联在成员协会的强烈反对下放弃了将其部分业务股权出售给外部投资者的提议。该决定反映了成员组织对维持对该组织控制权的担忧。
